 Live updates: Sixers take a nine-point lead over the Knicks into the fourth quarter 
 Follow along for live updates as the Sixers host the Knicks in their NBA Cup opener. 
 By Karli Cauley • 
 Published 5 hours ago • 
 Updated 16 minutes ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Share 
 IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect 
 Oct 30, 2026; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; New York Knicks guard Jalen Brunson (11) looses control of the ball in front of Philadelphia 76ers guard Kentavious Caldwell-Pope (1) during the second quarter at Xfinity Mobile Arena. Mandatory Credit: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images
 What to Know
 The Sixers enter at 4-1, while the Knicks are 2-3.
 Jaylen Brown was downgraded to out with left knee tendinopathy.
 Jose Alvarado is out with a left ankle sprain. Karl-Anthony Towns will play after being listed as probable with a left wrist sprain.
 Philadelphia beat New York 106-100 in the season opener behind Tyrese Maxey’s 28 points.
 The Sixers overcame a 13-point deficit entering the fourth quarter to beat Indiana on Wednesday.
 Jalen Brunson had 38 points and seven assists in Wednesday’s win over Chicago.
 The Knicks begin their NBA Cup title defense riding a two-game winning streak.
 Tip off is set to begin at 7:30 p.m. ET on Prime.

 An under-the-radar factor in Sixers' strong start
 Oct 30, 2026; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; New York Knicks center Karl-Anthony Towns (32) drives against Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid (21) during the first quarter at Xfinity Mobile Arena. Mandatory Credit: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images 
 Credit to the Sixers for another good half in the turnover department.
 They committed just five giveaways in the first half and have a 17-10 advantage over the Knicks in points off of turnovers.
 Sixers head coach Nick Nurse cares about winning the turnover battle and his team has generally fared well there. According to Cleaning the Glass, the Sixers were a top-11 team in offensive turnover percentage each of the past three seasons. They entered Friday’s game ranked third in the NBA.
 Tyrese Maxey being a fixture as a low-turnover, high-usage, heavy-minute lead guard has played a large role. Still, it wouldn’t have been surprising if the Sixers had some ugly turnovers early in the season as a team with new stars intent on playing in transition whenever possible.
 For the most part, they’ve avoided the sort of sloppiness you’d usually see in such situations. It’s a major reason why they’ve started 4-1 and hold a halftime lead over New York.
